NGA.note: Document states no digital-skills training for civil servants.

facts.fact: The Accountant-General says IPPIS, the federal payroll system running since 2007, now covers 508 ministries, departments and agencies and more than 1,008,800 employee records.
The Federal Government launched the IPPIS Human Resource modules on 27 July 2026, a platform the Head of the Civil Service says replaced the Oracle E-Business Suite after testing.
